metrics.title: Pass play success
metrics.definition: Dropbacks excluding spikes: gain 40% of yards to go on first down, 60% on second, 100% on third/fourth.

metrics.title: Run play success
metrics.definition: Rushing plays excluding kneels and scrambles; the same 40/60/100 rule. Designed QB runs may remain.

metrics.title: Passing yards per attempt
metrics.definition: Observed pass attempts; recorded incompletions/interceptions contribute zero passing yards. Sacks and spikes excluded. This is not yards per dropback.

metrics.title: Rushing yards per carry
metrics.definition: Observed carries with known rushing yards; kneels and scrambles excluded. Run concepts are not inferred.

metrics.title: Sacks observed
metrics.definition: Sacks in supplied observed dropbacks with known sack flags; incomplete files do not establish complete season totals.
